notes: Case A board: no location filter of any kind — the probe's filter census reports zero native selects, zero comboboxes, zero checkbox facets and zero search boxes, so GOAL_PROMPT Step 1c routes this to Case A (extract every listing). The listing page carries no location text at all; locations live on the posting detail pages, which name Costa Rica / Remote / LATAM, so extracting the whole board is in scope for the target region and there is no subset to isolate. Derived prefix /careers is correct with no override. No suppression is needed either: the board renders one chrome anchor under the same prefix, /careers/why-oceans, but it is CSS-hidden and the anchor visibility gate already drops it — 8 anchors eligible including hidden, 7 after the gate. That is the gate doing exactly what it exists for, so a suppress_ancestor_selector here would be redundant config. expected_unfiltered_count=7 equals expected_jobs because there is no filter to apply, not because the URL carries one.
